title: Smart Views
description: Create dynamic, saved views that automatically update based on filters

steps.title: What are Smart Views?
steps.description: Smart Views are saved filter combinations that automatically show matching notes. They update in real-time as notes change.

steps.title: Create a View
steps.description: Apply filters (tags, properties, dates) then click 'Save View'

steps.title: Name the View
steps.description: Enter 'Active Project Alpha Tasks' and click Save

steps.title: Access from Sidebar
steps.description: The view appears in the sidebar under 'Smart Views' for one-click access

steps.title: View Options
steps.description: Right-click a view to edit filters, rename, duplicate, or delete. Set as default view for a workspace.

steps.title: Share Views
steps.description: Export view definitions as JSON to share with team members or import on another device
